messages.exclusion.currency_mismatch: The document is in a different currency from the account. Amounts are never converted.
messages.exclusion.date_unavailable: No usable document date was found.
messages.exclusion.total_not_positive: The total is zero or negative; only outflows are matched.
messages.exclusion.unreadable: The document could not be read.
messages.finding.ambiguous_match.explanation: {count} documents fit this transaction almost equally well, so none was chosen automatically.
messages.finding.ambiguous_match.title: More than one possible document
messages.finding.amount_mismatch.explanation: The bank amount ({bank_amount} {currency}) and the AI-read document total ({document_total} {currency}) differ by {difference} {currency}.
messages.finding.amount_mismatch.title: Possible amount difference
messages.finding.duplicate_document_exact.explana: This file was uploaded {copies} times with identical content. It was reviewed once.
messages.finding.duplicate_document_exact.title: Same file uploaded more than once
messages.finding.duplicate_document_probable.expl: {count} documents share the same vendor, date and total. They may be copies of one purchase.
messages.finding.incomplete_document.explanation: {count} problems were found while reading this document. Values that could not be read with certainty were not guessed.
messages.finding.incomplete_document.title: Document needs checking
messages.finding.missing_document.explanation: No uploaded document was matched to this outflow of {amount} {currency} on {date}. Outflows of {threshold} {currency} or more without a document are listed for review.
messages.finding.missing_document.title: Possibly missing document
messages.finding.unmatched_document.explanation: No bank transaction in this export was matched to this document.
messages.finding.unmatched_document.title: Document not matched to a transaction
messages.hint.currency_unconfirmed: The document's currency could not be confirmed. It was compared as the account currency, and nothing was converted.
messages.hint.date_ambiguous: A document date can be read more than one way. It was read using the configured date order.
messages.hint.lower_bank_amount: The bank amount is lower than the document total. This may be a partial payment, discount or credit.
messages.hint.tip_possible: The difference is small enough to be a tip.
messages.hint.vendor_not_comparable: The vendor names are written in different scripts and could not be compared. The match relies on amount and date only.
messages.issue.currency_ambiguous: The currency symbol is used by several currencies.
messages.issue.currency_unsupported: The currency differs from the account currency.
messages.issue.date_ambiguous: The document date can be read more than one way.
messages.issue.date_invalid: The document date could not be read as a date.
messages.issue.document_number_invalid: The document number could not be used.
messages.issue.document_type_missing: The document type was not found.
messages.issue.document_type_unrecognized: The document type was not recognized.
messages.issue.extraction_failed: The document could not be read by the extraction step.
messages.issue.subtotal_invalid: The subtotal could not be read as an amount.
messages.issue.tax_invalid: The tax could not be read as an amount.
messages.issue.tip_invalid: The tip could not be read as an amount.
messages.issue.total_invalid: The total could not be read as an amount.
messages.issue.total_not_positive: The total is zero or negative. This may be a refund or credit note.
messages.issue.vendor_invalid: The vendor name could not be used.
messages.next_action.check_document_fields: Check the listed fields against the document.
messages.next_action.check_other_account_or_perio: Check whether this document belongs to another account or period.
messages.next_action.choose_matching_document: Choose the document that belongs to this transaction.
messages.next_action.confirm_amount_difference: Confirm the reason for the amount difference.
messages.next_action.request_document: Request or attach the supporting document.
messages.next_action.upload_clearer_copy: Upload a clearer copy of the document.
messages.report.disclaimer: This report lists items that may need a bookkeeper's attention. It is not an accounting, audit, tax or legal conclusion, and it does not change any records. AI-read values may be wrong; check them against the documents.
